notes.title: Kharon's Crypt - Even Death May Die Full Release is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Early Access is Over[/h2]

Kharon's Crypt - Even Death May Die full release is out now on Steam and Nintendo Switch

This update will be taking the game out of early access into full release. It includes the Free Release Expansion that adds over 3 hours of content to the base game and a new hardcore game mode. 

The Crypt awaits you!

--
Hebi Lee
--------------------
Creator, Director & Producer
Andromeda Project█
